summary: A line drawn with the Line tool, or as a Polyline line segment, now keeps a Horizontal or Vertical relation when its end follows the horizontal or vertical guide from the line's own start, while Create relations is on. The relation is stored with the existing horizontal or vertical kind between the line's two endpoints, after the drawing's attachments, so no schema changes. The snap hint names it before the click, as Horizontal, Vertical, or after an attachment such as Point on line · Vertical. The end must be exactly level or plumb with the start; guides from other points, arcs, arc through-points and a line that closes a polyline on its start keep no relation, and Ctrl or Cmd places the end freely. Turning Create relations off releases pending horizontal and vertical relations with the attachments, and Undo last removes a segment's relation with it. These relations are optional: when the sketch already holds the line level or plumb, preparation names the repeated relation, the drawing is accepted once without it, and a short note says so. A drawing the sketch accepts still costs one solve. Trimming the end of such a line keeps the relation on the remaining piece. The Create relations checkbox's accessible name changes from Create coincident relations to Create relations, matching its visible label.
warning: Potentially breaking for automation that finds the drawing checkbox by its accessible name: it is now Create relations instead of Create coincident relations. Lines drawn by people may now carry horizontal and vertical relations they did not carry before; agents reading a sketch see them as ordinary removable relations. Older releases open these documents, because the relation kinds already exist. Agent append-sketch-entities requests never gain an inferred relation. No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output.

checklist.schema: No CAD schema change: inferred relations use the existing horizontal and vertical kinds. No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, storage, journal, worker reply or native buffer protocol change; the Rust solver and committed WebAssembly module are unchanged. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event or input-version behavior change. A drawing whose inferred relation the solver rejects as repeated retries at most twice inside the same submission, with the same identities, signal and base version, and never after an abort, another kind of error or a changed sketch; only one edit is accepted. WebMCP tools and their arguments are unchanged.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. Line and Polyline line segments keep a Horizontal or Vertical relation along their own start's guide while Create relations is on.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Saved documents open unchanged.
checklist.verification: cadSketchGeometrySnaps.test.ts checks that only a guide from the line start infers, on its own, with another guide, along a line and on an axis, and the hint wording. cadPathDrawing.test.ts checks that the draft stores, undoes and releases inferred relations and rejects an end that is not exactly level or plumb. cadFreshSketchDrawing.test.ts checks that inferred relations follow every attachment, that a line not exactly level or plumb rejects before any ID is used, and that a line closing a polyline never keeps one. cadSketchInferenceFallback.test.ts checks with the native solver that a polyline with inferred horizontal, vertical and horizontal lines passes the residual check and commits with one solve, that a horizontal relation repeating an existing one is named, dropped and the rest of the drawing commits with one note, that a failure naming only other relations is reported unchanged after one attempt, and that an abort or a changed sketch is never retried. cadSketchTrimExtend.test.ts checks that trimming the end of a drawn horizontal line keeps the relation on the remaining piece. CadSketchCanvasPicking.test.tsx checks the Line tool hint and stored relation, Ctrl and Create relations off, Polyline line and arc segments and the Point on line · Vertical hint. CadWorkbench.test.tsx checks that a rejected inferred relation is dropped, the line is accepted once with a note, and one Undo restores the sketch. CadSketchCanvasRender.test.tsx passes unchanged. The full Vitest suite (550 files, 6195 tests), lint, ui:check, build and the release check pass, and e2e cad-sketch-constraints, cad-sketch-placement, cad-sketch-editing, cad-sketch-point-on-line and cad-workflow pass in Chromium.

publicNotes.summary: Lines drawn along their start's guide stay horizontal or vertical.
changes: With Create relations on, a Line or Polyline line whose end follows the horizontal or vertical guide from its start keeps a Horizontal or Vertical relation. The snap hint names it before you click.
If the sketch already keeps the line level or plumb, the line is added without the repeated relation and a short note says so.
The Create relations checkbox now has the same accessible name as its label.
publicNotes.compatibility: Sketches keep using existing relation kinds, so earlier releases open them. Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged.
publicNotes.action: No action needed. Hold Ctrl or Cmd, or turn off Create relations, to place a line end without the relation. Automation that finds the checkbox by name should use Create relations.
